baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated masdar nouns jam'ahu and qur'anahu, each carrying the same object pronoun under inna 'alayna.
baseline_models.mechanism: J-M-' makes the first entrusted operation an integration that preserves every part, while Q-R-' makes the second operation recitation or teaching to a hearer. The parallel grammar distinguishes securing a whole from audibly enacting that whole.

activation_trace.role: Scattered parts becoming one collected whole supplies the integrative first operation.
Wholeness without scattering or loss specifies what the gathering preserves.
Reading, reciting, and teaching recitation supplies the audible and relational second operation.

changed_reading.before: A general assurance that the material will be remembered and spoken.
changed_reading.after: A two-operation custody claim: the material is first made losslessly whole and then that secured whole is recited to a receiver.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The immediate coordination of jam'ahu with qur'anahu.
baseline_models.mechanism: Because Q-R-' itself has a collecting branch, the second noun can echo rather than merely follow the first: gathering establishes the intact inventory, and recitation gathers those units again into an ordered temporal sequence.

activation_trace.role: Gathering scattered parts into one whole supplies stable integration.
Collecting and joining supplies a second, sequence-forming gathering inside qur'anahu.
Recitation turns that second gathering into an ordered audible performance.

changed_reading.before: Gathering and recitation are two unrelated divine tasks.
changed_reading.after: Recitation is a second mode of gathering: already-secured units are recollected in their proper audible order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The fronted responsibility construction inna 'alayna governing both coordinated nouns.
baseline_models.mechanism: The concerted-resolve branch of J-M-' lets 'upon Us' sound like an assumed commitment rather than a bare statement of capacity; collection and recitation are presented as duties whose execution does not depend on the addressee's control.

activation_trace.role: Concerted resolve gathering thought into one decision supplies the commitment quality of the first duty.
Recitation and teaching identify the communicative act covered by the same commitment.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports that God is able to collect and recite.
changed_reading.after: The verse voices a self-assumed undertaking to complete both integration and communicative delivery.

context_deltas.mechanism: The doubled opening oath places the later inna 'alayna promise inside a surah-scale assurance frame, strengthening the baseline sense of a committed undertaking.

activation_trace.role: Concerted resolve supplies the focus promise's determined commitment.
Recitation identifies the communicative performance included in the undertaking.
An oath apportioned to those it binds supplies solemn assurance at the surah's opening.
The repeated oath reinforces rather than merely introduces the assurance frame.

structural_cues: 75:1-2 repeat uqsimu before the focus promise.
75:17 and 75:19 repeat inna 'alayna around gathering, recitation, and clarification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the doubled oath and repeated responsibility formula; I infer that the oath's assurance carries into the focus undertaking. A live alternative is that the oath governs only the resurrection argument and does not specifically intensify 75:17.

changed_reading.before: A local statement assigning two acts to God.
changed_reading.after: A solemnly framed assurance that collection and recitation are obligations assumed by the speaker.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same J-M-' operation gathers disarticulated bones and converges the sun and moon, while taswiyah adds exact completion. These echoes enlarge jam'ahu from storage into sovereign, lossless reconstitution across bodily and cosmic scales.

activation_trace.role: Scattered parts becoming a collected whole anchors reconstitution in the focus noun.
Wholeness without loss makes exact preservation, not mere aggregation, the target state.
The direct gathering echo applies the scattered-to-whole image to bodily remains.
Solid bone supplies the dispersed material whose identity must be restored.
Intrinsic straightness and completion make the reassembly exact down to formed detail.
A second direct echo scales gathering from bodily parts to celestial bodies.
The sun supplies one normally distinct cosmic body brought into convergence.
The moon supplies the paired cosmic body whose separate order is overcome.

structural_cues: 75:3-4 moves from gathering bones to proportioning fingertips.
75:8-9 moves from the moon's eclipse to the sun and moon being gathered.
75:37-40 closes with formation from seminal material and the capacity to revive the dead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated J-M-', bones, exact proportioning, and celestial convergence; I infer that these operations lend the focus gathering a scale-spanning reconstitutive quality. Alternatively, the repetitions may display one power in separate domains without transferring bodily or cosmic texture into 75:17.

changed_reading.before: Gathering means retaining the units of an utterance.
changed_reading.after: Gathering is lossless reconstitution: even dispersed or differently ordered parts are brought into an exact whole before recitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The flanking sequence assigns distinct agency and order: the addressee must stop hasty tongue motion, divine recitation occurs, the addressee follows its trace, and clarification comes afterward. The focus pair is therefore the middle of a governed reception protocol.

activation_trace.role: Integration supplies the completed whole that precedes performance.
Reciting and teaching supplies the divine performance to which the recipient responds.
Motion opposed to stillness supplies the action that must cease before reception.
The tongue as speech organ locates the recipient's premature production.
Haste and premature advancement explain why tongue motion disrupts the proper order.
The verbal and nominal repetition makes divine recitation the condition preceding response.
Following behind supplies the recipient's properly sequenced action.
Uncovering meaning by speech or sign supplies the later clarification stage.

structural_cues: 75:16 prohibits an action, 75:17 assigns divine duties, 75:18 uses fa-idha and an imperative of following, and 75:19 adds clarification with thumma.
The object pronoun remains constant across movement, gathering, recitation, following, and clarification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the prohibition and ordered particles around four named acts; I infer a division of agency in which completion enables recitation, which enables following, which precedes clarification. A live alternative is that the particles mark discourse order without a strict cognitive process model.

changed_reading.before: The focus verse is an isolated promise of memory and recitation.
changed_reading.after: It is the central handoff in an ordered reception process: still the tongue, receive the completed recitation, follow it, then receive its clarification.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recurrence of haste in 75:16 and the 'immediate' in 75:20 links premature recitation to a wider preference for controlling what comes now. The focus assignment to God becomes a discipline of receiving on an appointed schedule rather than forcing arrival.

activation_trace.role: An appointed time arriving or being delayed supplies a temporal edge to qur'anahu.
Haste supplies the recipient's attempt to advance the act before its time.
The same haste image names the immediate realm that is preferred.
Love lodged in the heart makes immediacy a desire, not merely a speech error.
Leaving something supplies the cost of choosing the immediate.
Latter-ness after the first supplies the deferred horizon being abandoned.

structural_cues: The root 'A-J-L occurs immediately before the focus at 75:16 and again as al-'ajilah at 75:20.
75:20-21 contrast loving the immediate with leaving the latter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated haste root and the immediate/latter contrast; I infer that surrendering control of recitation timing is one local instance of the surah's temporal ethic. Alternatively, 75:20 may begin a new audience-level rebuke with no backward semantic effect on 75:17.

changed_reading.before: The verse relieves a technical problem of speaking too fast.
changed_reading.after: The verse also relocates temporal control: divine custody counters the desire to force an immediate result and trains reception of what arrives later.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby judgment sequence reports what a person sent ahead and deferred, sets inner sight against offered excuses, and later names clarification. Against that frame, gathering plus recitation can function as assembling and reading forth an inspectable account.

activation_trace.role: Collecting dispersed material into one whole supplies assembly of an account.
Reading to another supplies public or relational presentation of what was assembled.
A report that arrives and is conveyed supplies formal notification to the person.
Advancing and precedence sort what the person sent ahead into the account.
Deferral to a later time supplies the account's complementary delayed category.
Insight of the heart makes the subject internally capable of recognizing the evidence.
Excuse and exculpation supply the attempted counterstatement that the account withstands.
Disclosure of meaning by speech or sign supplies the account's explanatory completion.

structural_cues: 75:13-15 moves from notification, through categorized deeds, to self-evidence and excuses.
75:17-19 moves from assembly and recitation to clarification under the same 'upon Us' formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a forensic sequence and the focus operations of assembly and reading; I infer an evidentiary arrow from collected material to disclosed, clarified account. The live alternative is that the forensic frame concerns deeds while the focus pronoun refers only to revelation, leaving the relation analogical rather than referential.

changed_reading.before: Gathering and recitation describe private preservation and oral delivery.
changed_reading.after: They also form an evidentiary mechanism: material is assembled, read forth to a subject, and made resistant to excuse by clarification.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because pregnancy senses of both focus roots are form-distant from jam' and qur'an, but it remains anchored in explicit packet branches and is activated by the surah's fluid-attachment-creation-sex sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as a gestational analogy for protected formation, never as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Jam'ahu through the retained-pregnancy branch and qur'anahu through the womb-enclosure branch.

activation_trace.role: A pregnancy retained within the female supplies protected holding during formation.
A womb enclosing pregnancy supplies the bounded container in which the gathered content develops.
A clear drop extending through the sense of semen supplies the process's minimal fluid beginning.
Semen from which form is apportioned supplies generative material already directed toward shape.
Pregnancy taking hold in the womb supplies attachment and retained development.
Bringing a created form into existence supplies emergence from enclosure as a coherent whole.
A counterpart joined to its mate supplies the reproductive completion of the creation sequence.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes cognitive collection followed by vocal delivery.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, the entrusted content is gathered and enclosed through a protected formation until it can emerge as a coherent recitable whole.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The course or pattern branch is less immediate than ordinary recitation, yet the command to follow qur'anahu and later images of one-track driving keep it anchored. Render this as recitation laying out an ordered trajectory, not as a claim that Qur'an lexically means road.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Qur'anahu through the Q-R-' branch of manner, pattern, and directed course.

activation_trace.role: A manner, pattern, or directed course supplies recitation with sequential trajectory.
Tracing one mark after another turns the recipient's following into close tracking of that trajectory.
Successive movement in one trace supplies a later whole-surah image of compelled sequence.
A way, place, or method supplies a contrasting self-directed course after rejection.

changed_reading.before: Qur'anahu is only an auditory event to imitate.
changed_reading.after: The recitation lays down an ordered course whose successive units are to be tracked, making following temporal and directional as well as vocal.

strongest_changes: Direct J-M-' echoes at 75:3 and 75:9 turn gathering into lossless, scale-spanning reconstitution rather than mere retention.
The 75:16-19 sequence makes the focus verse a governed handoff: still premature speech, receive divine recitation, follow, then receive clarification.
The repeated haste root at 75:16 and 75:20 broadens the focus promise into a relinquishment of immediate temporal control.
The judgment frame permits a coexisting evidentiary reading in which assembled material is read forth and clarified against excuse.
summary.what_was_special: Both focus roots contain gathering branches, so recitation emerged as a second ordered gathering. The whole-surah package then activated oath, bodily and cosmic reconstitution, temporal discipline, judgment, and creation mechanisms without requiring them to collapse into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The bodily and cosmic gatherings may frame divine power analogically rather than semantically revise the focus noun.
The evidentiary model may be a whole-surah resonance while the focus pronoun remains narrowly revelatory.
The gestational and directed-track readings are branch-supported but form-distant and should remain explicitly qualified analogies.
